display.name: AISIX AI Gateway Monitoring Dashboard
display.description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for AISIX AI Gateway request rates, LLM model latency, token consumption, cache outcomes, policy guardrails, and upstream health.

display.name: job
display.description: Gateway scrape job

spec.queryValue: SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'job') AS `job` FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'aisix_llm_requests_total' GROUP BY `job`

display.name: instance
display.description: Gateway instance

spec.queryValue: SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'instance') AS `instance` FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'aisix_llm_requests_total' GROUP BY `instance`

display.name: environment_id
display.description: AISIX environment ID

spec.queryValue: SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'environment_id') AS `environment_id` FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'aisix_llm_requests_total' GROUP BY `environment_id`

display.name: provider
display.description: LLM Provider

spec.queryValue: SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'provider') AS `provider` FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'aisix_llm_requests_total' GROUP BY `provider`

display.name: model
display.description: LLM Model

spec.queryValue: SELECT JSONExtractString(labels, 'model') AS `model` FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4_1day WHERE metric_name = 'aisix_llm_requests_total' GROUP BY `model`

display.name: Request Rate (req/s)
display.description: LLM requests per second from aisix_llm_requests_total

display.name: Success Rate (%)
display.description: Percentage of LLM requests with outcome='success'

filter.expression: outcome = 'success' AND job IN $job AND instance IN $instance

display.name: In-flight Requests
display.description: Current requests grouped by endpoint or inbound protocol

display.name: Config Last Reload Status
display.description: Latest configuration reload timestamp

display.name: Rejected Configuration Resources
display.description: Rejected or partially compatible configuration resources count

display.name: End-to-End Latency (P50, P95, P99)
display.description: P50, P95, and P99 latency from aisix_request_e2e_latency_seconds

filter.expression: job IN $job AND instance IN $instance AND provider IN $provider AND model IN $model
job IN $job AND instance IN $instance AND provider IN $provider AND model IN $model
job IN $job AND instance IN $instance AND provider IN $provider AND model IN $model

display.name: Time to First Token (TTFT)
display.description: P50, P95, and P99 TTFT for streaming requests

job IN $job AND instance IN $instance AND provider IN $provider AND model IN $model

display.name: Requests by Provider & Model
display.description: Traffic distribution across providers and models

filter.expression: job IN $job AND instance IN $instance AND provider IN $provider AND model IN $model

display.name: Requests by Outcome
display.description: Traffic distribution grouped by request outcome

display.name: Input and Output Token Rate
display.description: Token consumption over time by type (input/output) and model

filter.expression: job IN $job AND instance IN $instance AND model IN $model

display.name: Cache Outcomes & Hit Ratio
display.description: Exact hits, semantic hits, misses, and bypasses when cache policy is enabled

display.name: Rate-Limit Rejections
display.description: Rejections grouped by configured scope

display.name: Guardrail Outcomes
display.description: Allowed, blocked, and bypassed guardrail activity

display.description: Upstream attempt failures by target model

display.name: Fallback Outcomes
display.description: Successful and failed fallback attempts

display.name: Deployment Target State
